name: In Favor of the Light

meta.wiki: In Favor of the Light (Elwynn Forest)
chain: In Favor of the Light (Elwynn Forest)

summary: At Northshire Abbey, Priestess Anetta sends you south to continue your training in Goldshire. Priestess Josetta waits at the Lion's Pride Inn to guide your next steps in the Holy Light.

sections.title: Stepping Beyond Northshire
sections.body: Your training carries you beyond Northshire Abbey's cloistered halls and into the lives of Elwynn's people. You leave secluded study for active ministry, where the Holy Light must answer everyday needs beyond the abbey's walls.

sections.title: Tutelage in Goldshire
sections.body: At the Lion's Pride Inn, Priestess Josetta tends to Goldshire's spiritual needs and guides rising acolytes. She builds on your lessons and teaches you to offer comfort, protect the faithful, and heal the injured. Under her guidance, you learn the duties of the Church's servants across the kingdom, including caring for a wounded guard and receiving ceremonial clerical vestments.

faq.q: Who starts this quest and who do I report to?
aliases: who gives in favor of the light
where to turn in in favor of the light
faq.answer: Priestess Anetta gives you instructions inside Northshire Abbey and sends you down the road to meet Priestess Josetta in Goldshire.

faq.q: Why is a priest sent away from Northshire so early?
faq.answer: Northshire teaches you the foundations of the Holy Light, while Goldshire lets you serve a real community. Under Josetta's direction, you can help townspeople and town guards.

faq.q: Where can Priestess Josetta be found in Goldshire?
faq.answer: Priestess Josetta is inside the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, where she trains priests.

faq.q: What happens after meeting Priestess Josetta?
aliases: next quest after in favor of the light
what follows in favor of the light
faq.answer: After you meet Priestess Josetta, she tests your training by asking you to care for a wounded guard and receive ceremonial clerical vestments.

faq.q: Is this quest restricted to priests?
aliases: can any class do in favor of the light
faq.answer: Yes. These teachings are for priest initiates learning to serve the Church of the Holy Light.

faq.q: What role does the Church of the Holy Light play in Elwynn?
aliases: church of the holy light role
faq.answer: The Church of the Holy Light offers comfort, spiritual guidance, and healing to townspeople and defenders facing bandits and dangerous wildlife in Elwynn.

angles.text: As a priest, you leave your sheltered studies in Northshire to serve the people and garrisons of Elwynn Forest.
As a human of Stormwind, you can seek the priesthood's guidance in Goldshire as you help uphold your kingdom's moral and spiritual life.
As an Alliance member, you can look to the Church of the Holy Light for healers who tend to those defending the Alliance.

attribution: In Favor of the Light (Elwynn Forest)
